args.name: rate
args.description: Exchange rate applied to the amounts

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE d(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM d WHERE i < 10)
SELECT date('now', '-' || (10 - i) || ' days') AS day, abs(random() % 50000) AS cents
FROM d
query.transform:
local out, total = {}, 0
for _, r in ipairs(rs.rows) do
  local amount = r[2] / 100 * args.rate
  total = total + amount
  out[#out + 1] = { day = r[1]:sub(6), amount = amount, total = total }
end
return { columns = { "day", "amount", "total" }, rows = out }
